backgrounds.label: Monolith Gate
backgrounds.use: hero, runtime boundary, launch, and system threshold
backgrounds.alt: A monumental engineered gate rising from an amber desert under windblown haze, with restrained blue energy seams.

backgrounds.label: Desert Foundry
backgrounds.use: compiler, package delivery, infrastructure, and technical editorial
backgrounds.alt: A weathered industrial foundry spread across desert dunes, with towering machinery and narrow orange furnace light.

backgrounds.label: Nocturne Lattice
backgrounds.use: live sessions, code, event streams, agents, and operational night
backgrounds.alt: A vast nocturnal machine city connected by bridges, lit by sparse amber lamps and cool blue apertures.

backgrounds.label: Reliquary Engine
backgrounds.use: VM, WASM, native runtime, protected state, and archival systems
backgrounds.alt: An ancient engineered chamber centred on a circular golden machine, with carved stone, metal ribs, and faint electrical arcs.

backgrounds.label: Storm Archive
backgrounds.use: network operations, incidents, durable work, and charged status surfaces
backgrounds.alt: A fortress tower anchors a desert storm while blue electrical pressure gathers above radial industrial conduits.

backgrounds.label: Ink Conduit
backgrounds.use: dataflow, orchestration, editor launch, and spatial tooling
backgrounds.alt: A dark brass machine hall opens toward a distant desert tower while cyan energy filaments move through suspended conduits.

textures.label: Silica Drift
textures.use: mineral surfaces, light panels, covers, and restrained canvas grain

textures.label: Oxide Patina
textures.use: foundry panels, aged infrastructure, borders, and editorial crops
textures.alt: A weathered brass and oxidised copper surface with dark steel, teal patina, pitting, and warm metallic wear.

textures.label: Carbon Weave
textures.use: dark editor surrounds, equipment panels, code canvases, and dense material depth
textures.alt: A dark woven carbon material with distressed folds, soot, fine filament structure, and subtle bronze dust.

textures.label: Phase Glass
textures.use: inspection surfaces, overlays, optical panels, and cool state transitions
